causes.text: Tesla slashed prices globally by up to 20%, cutting the cost of models such as the Model 3 and Model Y in China, Europe and the United States, which analysts said would intensify competition and pressure rivals to follow suit.

source_info.title: Tesla turns up heat on rivals with global price cuts

effects.text: Two months later, BYD announced discounts of 8,888 yuan on its Song Plus and 6,888 yuan on the Seal sedan, marking the company's first major markdowns in response to Tesla's aggressive price cuts.

source_info.title: Chinese EV comptition hots up as BYD offers discounts

causal_reasoning_chain.description: Tesla's sweeping price cuts across the globe lowered the reference price for electric cars and signaled intensifying competition.
Industry analysts speculated that other automakers would need to reduce prices to avoid losing market share to Tesla.
BYD responded by offering discounts of 8,888 yuan on its Song Plus SUV and 6,888 yuan on the Seal sedan, aligning its pricing with new market norms.
Following the discount announcement, BYD's Hong Kong-listed shares slipped roughly 1.5% as investors worried about margin compression amid the emerging price war.

rationale: Tesla's aggressive price cuts reset consumer expectations and heightened competitive pressure, prompting BYD to introduce significant discounts on its popular models to defend market share. The temporal proximity and industry commentary suggest a causal link.
counterfactual_analysis: Had Tesla not slashed prices, BYD likely would have maintained its previous pricing strategy, preserving margins and avoiding the need for promotional discounts.

adversarial_confounders.impact: Changing consumer demand around the Lunar New Year period may have influenced BYD's discount timing irrespective of Tesla's pricing.

details.commentary: Large cloud and telecom customers can pressure Broadcom on pricing or shift some spend to rivals when macro conditions soften. Signs of tighter budgets and slower orders from key buyers reduced Broadcom's near-term revenue visibility and kept its valuation in check.
